body:
Looks like this is being caused by 50311f1, which was removed from `4-0-stable` after a [prescient comment](https://github.com/rails/rails/commit/1193a2738dc751cedcd6155076d68c9851680317#commitcomment-3474691) from @jeremy.

@drogus are you able to take a look? There may be a deeper problem here over whether a trailing slash should map to the same route or not.

issue.title: Rails 4.1.0 doesn't recognize paths with backslash in the end
issue.body:
Creating or upgrading a rails application give following behaviors

/foobars : 200 ok
/foobars/ : 404 error

body:
As mentioned in #13441, `get '/streams'` also fails (I just bumped into this while working on a 4.1 project, and verified by amending the test case @senny provided):

``` ruby
  def test_returns_success
    get '/streams'
    assert last_response.ok? # passes

    get '/streams/'
    assert last_response.ok? # fails

    get '/?author=senny'
    assert last_response.ok? # passes

    get '/streams/?author=senny'
    assert last_response.ok? # fails
  end
```

After looking at it quite extensively I don't see any easy way to overcome this problem, so I think I will have to revert 50311f1. My plan of attack was to use `normalize_path` late and don't set `PATH_INFO` with changes, but this will not work properly anyway: `PATH_INFO` [can be later changed](https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/50311f1391ddd8e0349d74eb57f04b7e0045a27d/actionpack/lib/action_dispatch/journey/router.rb#L66).

If no one has ideas on how to tackle this, I will revert early next week (I would like to have another look at it over the weekend).

Thanks @drogus. I just noticed that requests to URLs like `/blog/` started failing with the move to 4.1.0.beta1 (`/blog` still works, of course). It would be good to ensure the revert gets in before 4.1.0 goes final.

I've reverted the commit and added a failing test to ensure that this regression won't be introduced again. I pushed the revert only to master, because I don't see and branch for `4.1.0`, is that correct?

issue.title: [4.1.0.beta1] get "/:something" no longer matches "/something/" (with trailing slash)
issue.body:
Hey guys,

Running into a problem with [teaspoon](https://github.com/modeset/teaspoon) on Rails 4.1.0.beta1. My app has some issue with current master so I cannot verified if this has been fixed yet.

Essentially all test suites return `No route matches [GET] "/teaspoon/default/"`. This is the URL that these test cases run on:

`http://localhost:3000/default/?file=<path_to_some_file>`

From the gem you can see that the [route file](https://github.com/modeset/teaspoon/blob/master/config/routes.rb) is declared as follows:

```
Teaspoon::Engine.routes.draw do
  get "/fixtures/*filename", to: "spec#fixtures"
  get "/:suite", to: "spec#runner", defaults: { suite: "default" }
  post "/:suite/hooks(/:group)", to: "spec#hooks", defaults: { suite: "default", group: "default" }
  root to: "spec#suites"
end
```

So it seems like `get "/:suite"` no longer maps `http://localhost:3000/default/`? I tried running the test suites through `http://localhost:3000/default` (without trailing slash) and they work.

body: I'm still seeing this in the RC (4.1.0.rc1), which is odd seeing as I can definitely see the revert is contained in that branch. Is anybody else still seeing this?
